kwoe01.title: Left on Read
kwoe01.caption:
Left on read. Be honest, which one are you?
Re-read it, posted a selfie, went back to work or typed and deleted all night. Drop your number below.

kwoe02.title: The Six-Minute Voice Note
kwoe02.caption:
They sent a six-minute voice note. Now what?
Replay one sigh, burrito up, speed it up or play it for the friends. Pick your number.

kwoe03.title: The Crush Walks In
kwoe03.caption:
Your crush just walked in. What do you do?
Walk over, freeze mid-bite, stare at a poster or fix your hair. We know your number.

kwoe04.title: The 2 a.m. Scroll
kwoe04.caption:
It is 2 a.m. and you are still scrolling.
Endless tabs, old photos, your own profile or an octopus documentary. Which one are you?

kwoe05.title: First Date Nerves
kwoe05.caption:
First date tonight. How are the nerves?
Whole closet on the floor, early with notes, forgot it was today or a mirror pep talk. Your number goes in the comments.

kwoe06.title: "I Like You"
kwoe06.caption:
Someone just said "I like you." Your move?
Snacks, a definition, a picnic plan or a panicked "LIKE like?" Tell us your number.

kwoe07.title: The Ex Liked Your Photo
kwoe07.caption:
Your ex just liked your photo. How do you react?
One raised eyebrow, a new post, too busy to see it or straight to the group chat. Which number?

kwoe08.title: Single at the Wedding
kwoe08.caption:
Single at the wedding? Pick your role.
Dance floor legend, centrepiece fixer, bouquet diver or the one talking about space. Number in the comments, please.

kwoe09.title: They Replied "k"
kwoe09.caption:
They replied with just "k." Breathe.
Make a sandwich, panic-reply, study it closely or stare without blinking. Who are you here?

kwoe10.title: The Friend Who Asks for Advice
kwoe10.caption:
Your friend needs dating advice. What kind of friend are you?
Slideshow, both sides forever, "be weird about it" or your own story. We want your number.
